topics.summary: AFFiNE (docs+whiteboard, local-first) and NoteDiscovery (self-hosted KB with MCP for AI agents) as knowledge-workspace options.
AI stack uses Qwen3.5/3.6/3.8 models via Ollama, Claude Agent SDK for agents/sub-agents, Qdrant for RAG, nomic-embed-text for embeddings, Whisper+Piper for voice, Unsloth Desktop for LoRA training.
Multi-layer comms: WiFi LAN, LoRa/Meshtastic mesh, SDR (RTL-SDR), satellite (Starlink Mini, Garmin inReach), Matrix Synapse chat, ntfy push notifications.
Multi-language UI with LLM-powered translation (100% with validation), human-in-the-loop review, and community contributions.
Deep research findings: Survival LLM competitor, Qwen3.8-Flash-Next, Unsloth Desktop, Meshtastic 2.8/MeshCore 1.18, Hikma Health, AFFiNE, NoteDiscovery, Needle 2.
IoT ecosystem with ESP32 sensors, MQTT/Mosquitto, Home Assistant, Node-RED, Grafana/InfluxDB. Solar power with LiFePO4, MPPT, INA226 monitoring.
Options for running NOMAD Hyper across a local network: distributed model inference, shared storage, mesh, and edge nodes over cable/WiFi.
NOMAD Hyper supports multiple locations (regions/cities) with multi-select for content (ZIM, maps, weather, plants, comms frequencies).
Comparison and integration guidance for MeshCore (v1.18, Oct 2026) alongside existing Meshtastic support in NOMAD Hyper.
Latest model and tool updates as of Nov 2026: Ollama 0.40.15, Qwen3.6/3.8, Unsloth Desktop, DeepSeek V4 distilled, MLX support.
New modules from deep research: Wyoming voice stack, Dockhand, Vaultwarden, Audiobookshelf, Calibre-Web, Docmost, Syncthing, Restic, ArchiveBox, Homepage, and more.
OpenSpec spec-driven development. Workflow: explore -> propose -> apply -> verify -> archive. Artifacts: proposal.md, specs/, design.md, tasks.md.
NOMAD Hyper is an offline-first knowledge and education server forked from Project NOMAD, extended with AI agents, IoT, LoRa, SDR, solar power, voice, and Unsloth LoRA training.
Five parallel agent reports: emergency sources (80+), AI models, comms (MeshCore/Reticulum/SDR), medical (Hikma/MenSung), power/IoT (MPPT/BMS/HA). All under brain/research/agents-2026/.
Additional features to fill NOMAD Hyper for survival scenarios: mesh, power, medical, navigation, comms, food, water, security.
Required tools/libraries/frameworks for NOMAD Hyper: existing stack + new additions for i18n, multi-location, RAG, voice, mesh, etc.
LoRA training with Unsloth on 4GB GPU + CPU locally and in parallel in cloud. Internal API for training jobs. Roadmap for additional models.
Gap analysis of original Project NOMAD v1.35.1: features present vs missing, based on codebase exploration.
